# Synthetic regression inputs

These six small CSVs are authored for this repository's SQL regression suite. They contain fictional people and transactions, not the full learning dataset.

The suite tests duplicate customer selection, current product versions, an invalid calendar date, repaired sales/price values, an unmatched customer/product, fractional averages, and inclusive customer lifespans.

Only copy these files into the loader paths of a disposable test database/container. See [data quality documentation](../../docs/data_quality.md).
